comment: Metric-view base for the TB trade-finance view (D13 record_type union): record_type 'Issuance' = one row per instrument on its issue date (issuance USD, 1 transaction, fee USD, tenor days; from fact_trade_finance_transaction, Apr-2023 onwards, complete from FY2024) and record_type 'Outstanding' = one row per live instrument per month-end from Apr-2024 (outstanding USD; from fact_trade_outstanding_monthly). Both carry the same dimensions (product, corridor from / to, commodity, booking / beneficiary / counterparty-bank country, tenor bucket, expiry quarter, carbon-intensive and sustainable flags). Issuance / transactions / fee / tenor columns are flows and are 0 on Outstanding rows; outstanding_usd is POINT-IN-TIME (one month-end; never sum across months) and 0 on Issuance rows. Fee yield bps = 10000 x SUM(fee_usd) / SUM(issuance_usd); average tenor = SUM(tenor_days_issued) / SUM(transactions). Grain: one row per record_type x instrument x record_date (issue date or month-end).
